verdict.rationale: An AI insights feature is a fair axis for a cloud file-storage product, so the story applies. The evidence pack documents only file access, sharing, search, versioning and Graph APIs. The single 'analytics' mention refers to file rendering features, not AI-generated insights or suggestions, so the product shows no capability for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
